abstracts: This project develops an intelligent library management system that automates book lending, return processes, and inventory tracking using RFID technology and machine learning algorithms to predict user preferences.

A comprehensive healthcare management system that digitizes patient records, appointment scheduling, and billing processes. The system includes predictive analytics for patient flow management and resource allocation optimization.

An interactive e-learning platform that provides course management, student tracking, and assessment tools. The system incorporates adaptive learning algorithms to personalize content delivery based on student performance.

A complete food delivery application that connects restaurants, delivery personnel, and customers. Features include real-time order tracking, payment integration, and recommendation systems based on user preferences.

A cloud-based inventory management solution that helps businesses track stock levels, sales, and orders across multiple locations. The system provides automated reordering and demand forecasting capabilities.

A student information system that manages academic records, attendance, grades, and communication between students, teachers, and parents. The system includes reporting tools for academic performance analysis.
An IoT-based agricultural monitoring system that tracks soil conditions, weather patterns, and crop health to optimize farming practices and increase yield through data-driven recommendations.
A secure digital wallet application that enables users to store, send, and receive money. The system includes transaction history, budgeting tools, and integration with multiple payment gateways.

A comprehensive real estate platform that manages property listings, client information, and transaction processes. The system includes virtual tours, property valuation tools, and market analysis features.

An online platform for booking tours, hotels, and travel packages. Features include user reviews, itinerary planning, and AI-powered travel recommendations based on user preferences and location data.
